fonts.display: 'AeonikPro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'DotConnect', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Bone Canvas
palette.role: Primary page background, card surfaces, light text on dark — warm off-white reads as paper, not screen

palette.name: Charcoal Ink
palette.role: Primary text, headings, primary action fill, dominant borders — near-black with a barely-perceptible cool tint that distinguishes it from pure #000

palette.name: Smoke Veil
palette.role: Secondary text and borders for body-level elements — a half-step lighter than Charcoal for visual hierarchy without contrast loss

palette.name: Ash Layer
palette.role: Elevated card backgrounds, subtle surface differentiation, hover states — a warm gray that complements the bone canvas without going cold

palette.name: Mist Border
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, section separators — barely visible structural lines

palette.name: Ember
palette.role: Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Outlined action border for secondary interactive elements — ghost-button strokes only, never filled
